author: Good Enough
description:
The Most Deformed Animals Humans Have Made explores how selective breeding created some of the most unhealthy and genetically extreme animals on Earth. From French bulldogs, pugs, Persian cats, and Scottish Fold cats to Belgian Blue cattle, broiler chickens, ligers, and exotic bully dogs, discover the unintended consequences of breeding animals for appearance, size, and profit.

This video covers fancy goldfish, fancy pigeons, fancy rabbits, ligers, Belgian Blue cattle, Persian cats, pugs, English bulldogs, teacup dogs, broiler chickens, Scottish Fold cats, meat-farmed turkeys, Cavalier King Charles Spaniels, French bulldogs, exotic French bulldogs, and Exotic Bully dogs. Learn why each breed was created, the traits humans selected for, and the serious health problems many now face as a result of selective breeding.
